archivedStages.label: Spec
archivedStages.note: Spec committed 37f97d5 (docs/design/ask-xavier-queries-spec.md). USER pivot after 'on-device not as good as BYOK': stop expanding write-CRUD, ship the READ side where FM won't feel second-class. Read-only tool belt (7 tools over existing balances.ts math, rendered by the existing Donut/Bar/MultiLine/Sparkline components) — model PLANS (picks tool + enum params incl. period TOKENS), deterministic code COMPUTES, cards render tool results (model prose is a secondary caption, never the numbers). Ladder: BYOK = multi-round native tool loop (composition, 3-round cap); FM = single-shot generateObject tool selection (proven pattern, no unproven native loop); floor = canned shapes. Zero destructive risk → no confirm cards. WORKSTREAM A FIRST (user-directed): convert the intent gate to eval-driven — labeled tests/intent-corpus.jsonl porting ~150 collision cases from 5 adversarial rounds + ≥40 query cases, npm run eval:intent with a 100% bar, 'no gate change without corpus cases' rule.

history.title: Ask-Xavier deterministic period extraction (device-found)
history.note: Committed 9fe0860 (1158 tests). 'how much income for year 2026' answered with THIS MONTH — root cause was a doctrine violation: no deterministic period extraction existed, so the model's token ran as-is and an explicit year was inexpressible → silent this_month. resolvePeriodFromText now reads relative phrases + explicit years + months from the user's words and OVERRIDES the model at all 3 tiers; PeriodSpec widened internally while the model-facing enum stays closed. 2 QA rounds: the first override collapsed multi-round COMPARISONS (regression from the coordinator's own spec) → now applies only when exactly ONE period is named; floor net_worth ignored the period entirely. Unmodelled shapes (Q1, 'since 2020') return null rather than a silently wider range.

history.title: BYOK keychain-persist fix — key never saved on device (AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK + verify-on-save)
history.note: ✅ DEVICE-CONFIRMED (build 46, delivery 332d2805). Reproduce-first diagnosis: built app/debug-byok.tsx probe, reproduced with the user's real key + exact input, ruled out transport/model/isOnline/secureTextEntry, pinned the real bug — the BYOK key never persisted on a signed device (secureStore.ts WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY vs the working DB key's AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK); 'Test key' masked it by testing the in-memory pasted key, never the keychain. Fix: AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK + verify-on-save (write→read-back→key-free ByokKeyPersistError) so a failed save can't be a silent success. QA found 2 Majors (native-throw bypass, provider-switch race) → fixed + re-gated; reviewer APPROVE-WITH-NITS (applied). commit 3c187eb, 610 tests. Sim-verified save→'A key is saved'→parse→http 200→confirm. On device: key persists + Test-key green + parsing works (the 'add an account first' block was just a fresh reinstall, not a parse failure). main untouched (063563e).
